messages.author: Pirkko Portti
messages.text: Arvo, I'm at TRN-051, errors on xe-0/1/1 since the upgrade this morning.

messages.author: Arvo Aallonpituus
messages.text: What firmware did it go to?

messages.author: Pirkko Portti
messages.text: 6.1. It's one of the generation 2 boxes.

messages.author: Arvo Aallonpituus
messages.text: On 6.x I'd look at the FEC setting first. As far as I know the upgrade can reset it to default, and then you get errors like that with a perfectly good link. Check that it matches the far end before you touch the optics.

messages.author: Pirkko Portti
messages.text: FEC was off at our end. Turned it on, errors stopped on TRN-051.

messages.author: Arvo Aallonpituus
messages.text: Good. Note it in the ticket.
